text:
Predicates:
Pets(x) ::: x is a pet.
AllowedInManagedBuilding(x) ::: x is allowed in managed buildings.
DepositRequired(y) ::: a deposit is required to rent apartment y.
DepositAmount(y, z) ::: the deposit amount for y is z.
Rent(y, r) ::: the rent for apartment y is r.
Owner(x, y) ::: x owns y.
MoveInWith(x, y) ::: x can move in with y.
Tom ::: the individual named Tom.
Fluffy ::: the cat named Fluffy.
Apartment(y) ::: y is an apartment.
OliveGarden ::: the Olive Garden building.
Premises:
Pets(Fluffy) ::: Fluffy is a pet.
AllowedInManagedBuilding(Fluffy) ::: Fluffy is allowed in managed buildings.
Apartment(oliveGarden) ::: The Olive Garden is an apartment.
Rent(oliveGarden, 2000) ::: The rent at the Olive Garden is $2000.
Pets(Fluffy) ::: Fluffy is a pet.
Cats(x) ::: x is a cat.
Cats(Fluffy) ::: Fluffy is a cat.
AllowedInManagedBuilding(oliveGarden) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building.
DepositRequired(oliveGarden) ::: a deposit is required to rent an apartment in the Olive Garden.
DepositAmount(oliveGarden, d) ::: the deposit amount for the Olive Garden is d.
DepositAmount(oliveGarden, 1500) ::: the deposit amount is no more than $1500.
Rent(oliveGarden, 2000) ::: rent is $2000.
DepositAmount(oliveGarden, 1500) ::: the deposit is no more than $1500.
Tom ≡ tom ::: for simplicity.
Fluffy ≡ fluffy.
MoveInWith(tom, fluffy) ::: Tom can move in with Fluffy.
∃y (Apartment(y) ∧ AllowedInManagedBuilding(y) ∧ MoveInWith(tom, Fluffy) ∧ DepositAmount(y, d) ∧ d ≤ 1500) ::: There exists an apartment y in a managed building, which Tom can move in with Fluffy, and the deposit is no more than $1500.
Conclusion:
Rent(y, 2000) ∧ AllowedInManagedBuilding(y) ∧ Pets(Fluffy) ∧ MoveInWith(tom, Fluffy) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in The Olive Garden.
